import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = data.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
product_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color='steelblue')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by Age Group
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
age_sales = data.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(age_sales))
age_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=colors)
ax2.set_title('Total Sales by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_counts = data['payment_method'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'], startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sales by Hour
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
data['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(data['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
hourly_sales = data.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax4.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='darkgreen')
ax4.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3, color='lightgreen')
ax4.set_title('Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
takeaway_sales = data.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
ax5.bar(labels, takeaway_sales.values, color=['coral', 'skyblue'])
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 6. Product Size Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
size_counts = data['size'].value_counts()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_counts = size_counts.reindex(size_order, fill_value=0)
ax6.bar(size_counts.index, size_counts.values, color=['#ffd700', '#ff8c00', '#ff4500'])
ax6.set_title('Product Size Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Size')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')

# 7. Average Price by Product
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
avg_price = data.groupby('product')['price'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
avg_price.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax7, color='teal')
ax7.set_title('Average Price by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Average Price ($)')
ax7.set_ylabel('Product')

# 8. Quantity Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax8.hist(data['quantity'], bins=range(1, data['quantity'].max()+2), 
         color='mediumpurple', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_title('Quantity Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Quantity')
ax8.set_ylabel('Frequency')

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
